_comment: Claims with known answers for scripts/benchmark-claims.mjs. `page` is a saved state: claim-states/<name>.json (UI states, capture-claim-states.mjs) or read-states/<name>.json (content pages, shared with the read benchmark). `expect` is pass or fail. `events` (optional) is what the runner would show Jev (dialogs, downloads, pageerror, console.error). Types: outcome (the result of a flow, as an expect step says it), fact (a detail on the page), near (one detail is wrong), absent (not on the page at all), state (a control's state), negation (says something is not there), count, order, event (judged from events, not the page), compound (two parts, often one false), quantifier (all, every, at least one), superlative (the most, the cheapest, more than), swap (a true value of another row or field), scope (true elsewhere on the page, not where the claim says).
